messages:
acme-frontend: Hey, hitting a customer escalation — long-running SSE responses getting truncated mid-stream and clients auto-reconnecting ~30s after start. Seen across multiple regions, started after we turned on Cloudflare Argo last week. request_id=6a3f9c. We can reproduce consistently with a single client.

Ian (support): Sorry to hear that — can you paste a curl reproduction and your ingress (ALB/NLB/Cloudflare) headers? Also any proxy between CF and origin?

acme-frontend: Repro steps: 1) curl -N -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" https://api.acme.example/stream?session=foo 2) stream emits ~120 tokens then a blank pause, then connection drops, client reconnects. Minimal run: `curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?session=test\"` returns first 2 chunks then FIN.

acme-frontend: tcpdump shows FIN from 10.1.2.5 (ALB) shortly after Cloudflare idle probe hits origin (we think). Attached pcap to ticket (link: https://acme.atlassian/INC-912). Billing note: reconnections cause doubled tokens charged, customer unhappy.

Maya (eng-oncall): @Sam could you check ALB idle timeout and whether we see half-close ordering? Also check whether Cloudflare worker changed probe interval.

Sam (infra): Confirmed ALB idle timeout is 15s for that target group (legacy). Cloudflare's keepalive/probe interval to origin is 30s for our plan; mismatch could cause ALB to see connection as idle and close while CF still expects it open -> early FINs.

Sam (infra): Also looking at origin nginx config: `proxy_buffering on; proxy_send_timeout 30s; keepalive_timeout 10;` that's not ideal for long SSE. Nginx will buffer and might close upstream.

Ian (support): Suggested quick workarounds for acme-frontend to try: 1) set ALB idle timeout >= 60s (or >= CF probe interval + slack) 2) set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_send_timeout 120s; keepalive_timeout 65;` on origin nginx 3) add `Connection: keep-alive` and `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` explicitly from upstream if possible.

acme-frontend: Trying ALB to 60s now. Also applied `proxy_buffering off` and `proxy_send_timeout 120s` in staging. Will report.

ops-bot: [deploy:nginx-prod] nginx config update by acme-frontend applied to staging (started).

acme-frontend: Staging test looks better — stream continues past 300 tokens, no FIN yet. Production change queued.

Maya (eng-oncall): We should also instrument server to emit periodic SSE keepalive comments (`: keepalive\n\n`) every 10s to prevent proxies from treating stream as idle. That plus adjusting timeouts is robust.

Ian (support): For longer-term: recommend customer migrate to our dedicated streaming route (edge-optimized) which uses different routing and keeps persistent connections through our TPU. Also recommend we add a docs note about ALB/Cloudflare timeout mismatch and standard nginx SSE config.

acme-frontend: One more oddity — some clients report a 502 from ALB immediately before the FIN. Packet trace shows ALB sends 502 when it thinks target is unhealthy after repeated idle closes. Possibly health checks overlapping with keepalive windows.

Sam (infra): Action items: 1) We'll open infra ticket to review target group idle settings across customers on same stack and patch the autoscaling template to default to 60s. 2) Add detection in our metrics: spike in short-lived SSE connections per request_id. 3) Add billing guard to not double-charge tokens for immediate reconnect within X seconds.

Ian (support): I've escalated to billing and engineering (created INC-914). Billing tentative workaround: refund duplicate tokens for that customer's billing cycle while we fix routing.

Maya (eng-oncall): Follow-up repro steps for eng runtime team: run a client against origin via Cloudflare + ALB chain: `tcpdump` on origin to capture FIN, reproduce with `wrk` streaming client: `wrk --latency -t1 -c1 -d30s 'http://<cf->alb->origin>/v1/stream?session=test'` and compare sequence numbers. If FIN from ALB shows within 1-2s of CF probe -> mismatch.

Sam (infra): We also observed instances where gzip compression on the origin caused large initial buffer then silence; recommend disabling gzip for SSE endpoints: `gzip off;` in nginx location /v1/stream.

acme-frontend: Production roll applied, initial telemetry looks good. Thanks. Will keep open for 24h and confirm no billing spike.

Ian (support): Great. If it reoccurs, please capture pcap and we'll engage eng-runtime to check our keepalive behavior and streaming kernel settings. For now marking as monitoring. :thumbsup:
